conditions.name: Addicted
conditions.sourceText: The creature has dependence on a named substance. Without a maintenance dose after a long rest, it gains Withdrawal.

conditions.name: Bleeding
conditions.sourceText: Take damage equal to proficiency bonus at the end of each turn. An action and Medicine check or magical healing ends it.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.sourceText: Cannot see; automatically fails sight checks; attacks have disadvantage and attacks against it have advantage.

conditions.name: Burning
conditions.sourceText: Take fire damage at end of turn. An action, immersion, or successful Dexterity save ends it.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.sourceText: Cannot willingly harm the charmer; charmer has advantage on social checks against it.

conditions.name: Corrupted
conditions.sourceText: Healing is reduced, corruption-sensitive effects worsen, and long rests may shift behavior or form until cleansed.

conditions.name: Dazed
conditions.sourceText: Choose either action or movement on the turn, not both; no bonus action.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.sourceText: Cannot hear and fails hearing checks; verbal coordination may fail.

conditions.name: Exhausted
conditions.sourceText: Use the six-level exhaustion track; effects are cumulative and level 6 is death.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.sourceText: Disadvantage while source is visible and cannot willingly move closer.

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.sourceText: Speed 0; ends if grappler is incapacitated or reach is broken.

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.sourceText: Cannot take actions or reactions.

conditions.name: Intoxicated
conditions.sourceText: Disadvantage on precise Dexterity and Intelligence checks; advantage on one save against fear. Stacks worsen into Dazed and Unconscious.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.sourceText: Cannot be seen normally; attacks against it have disadvantage and its attacks have advantage until location is revealed.

conditions.name: Marked
conditions.sourceText: A named creature or faction can track, target, or trigger abilities against the marked creature.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.sourceText: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, adjacent hits are critical.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.sourceText: Incapacitated stone-like state; resistance to damage, immunity to poison/disease, weight ×10.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.sourceText: Disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.sourceText: Crawl or stand; melee attackers within 5 ft. have advantage; ranged attackers have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Resonance Burn
conditions.sourceText: Maximum RP reduced and spell failure risk increases until a long rest or treatment.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.sourceText: Speed 0; attacks against have advantage, own attacks and Dexterity saves have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Silenced
conditions.sourceText: Cannot use verbal components, command words, Chants, or audible coordination.

conditions.name: Staggered
conditions.sourceText: Cannot react, loses Guard, and the next forced movement gains +5 ft. Ends at start of next turn.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.sourceText: Incapacitated, cannot move, fails Strength/Dexterity saves, attacks against have advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.sourceText: Incapacitated, unaware, drops held items, falls Prone, adjacent hits are critical.

conditions.name: Unity Exposure
conditions.sourceText: Track exposure from 0-6. At thresholds, distinctions, memories, loyalties, and eventually identity begin to erode.

conditions.name: Withdrawal
conditions.sourceText: Disadvantage on ability checks and RP recovery; severity depends on substance and duration of dependence.

conditions.name: Wounded
conditions.sourceText: Each Wound imposes -1 Constitution saves and reduces Hit Dice recovery; three Wounds is Critical.

v6Appendix.text: Appendix A: Conditions
The following conditions can affect characters and creatures in Decennium Descent. Each condition has specific rules that override general game rules.
Blinded
You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.
Attack rolls against you have advantage, and your attack rolls have disadvantage.
Charmed
You can't attack the charmer or target them with harmful abilities or magical effects.
The charmer has advantage on any ability check to interact socially with you.
Corrupted
Your alignment shifts one step toward evil at the end of each long rest unless you succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw.
You have disadvantage on saving throws against spells and abilities from evil creatures.
Healing effects only restore half the normal amount of hit points to you.
You emit a faint aura detectable by spells that reveal evil.
Deafened
You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.
Exhaustion
Exhaustion is measured in six levels. Effects are cumulative.
Disadvantage on ability checks
Speed halved
Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws
Hit point maximum halved
Speed reduced to 0
Death
Frightened
You have disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of your fear is within line of sight.
You can't willingly move closer to the source of your fear.
Grappled
Your speed becomes 0, and you can't benefit from any bonus to your speed.
The condition ends if the grappler is incapacitated.
The condition also ends if an effect removes you from the reach of the grappler.
Incapacitated
You can't take actions or reactions.
Invisible
You are impossible to see without special senses or magic.
You are heavily obscured for hiding.
Your location can be detected by noises or tracks.
Attack rolls against you have disadvantage.
Your attack rolls have advantage.
Paralyzed
You are incapacitated and can't move or speak.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have advantage.
Any attack that hits you from within 5 feet is a critical hit.
Petrified
You are transformed into an inanimate substance (usually stone).
Your weight increases tenfold, and you cease aging.
You are incapacitated, can't move or speak, and are unaware of surroundings.
Attack rolls against you have advantage.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
You have resistance to all damage.
You are immune to poison and disease, though existing poisons and diseases are suspended, not neutralized.
Poisoned
You have disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
Prone
Your only movement option is to crawl, unless you stand up.
You have disadvantage on attack rolls.
Attack rolls against you have advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet; otherwise, they have disadvantage.
Restrained
Your speed becomes 0, and you can't benefit from bonuses to speed.
Attack rolls against you have advantage.
Your attack rolls have disadvantage.
You have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Stunned
You are incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have advantage.
Unconscious
You are incapacitated, can't move or speak, and are unaware of surroundings.
You drop whatever you're holding and fall prone.
You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against you have advantage.
Any attack that hits you from within 5 feet is a critical hit.
Wounded
You can't regain hit points except through magical healing or completing a long rest.
You have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.
If you take damage while at 0 hit points, you suffer one death saving throw failure.
This condition ends after receiving magical healing or completing a long rest.

dependenceAndIntoxication.text: Exhale a 15-ft cone dealing 3d6 chosen elemental damage, Dexterity save half.
Take 1d6 damage of the same type and roll on the Mutation complication table on an overdose.
Gain listed benefit and later crash.
Make Constitution save against dependence DC.
After three uses in seven days, effect duration halves unless dose doubles.
User needs a dose after each long rest or gains Withdrawal.
Taking more than two doses before a long rest causes a severe complication and advances dependence.
Medicine, Religion, Alchemy, or a recovery project; magic removes symptoms but not always dependence.
Relaxed: advantage on one save against fear; disadvantage on precise memory checks.
Unconscious for 1d4 hours; Constitution save against poisoning.
Medical emergency; gain a Wound or die without treatment at Director discretion.
39. Coin Shaving, Counterfeiting, and Goblin Finance

Coin shaving originated in early goblin trade networks as a way to capture fractions of value from irregular hand-struck coins. The practice spread far beyond goblin society. Goblin bankers later pioneered edge marks, assay scales, sealed rolls, and contractual weight standards partly to control the fraud their predecessors had industrialized. This history reflects institutions and incentives, not an inherent moral quality of every goblin.

magicalSubstances.name: Quickglass
magicalSubstances.description: Fine silver-blue flakes dissolved in a sealed draught.
magicalSubstances.effect: Gain +10 ft. speed and advantage on initiative for 10 minutes.
magicalSubstances.crash: Afterward, suffer 1 Strain and disadvantage on Dexterity checks for 1 hour.

magicalSubstances.name: Dreammilk
magicalSubstances.description: Pearlescent sap sold in waxed ampoules.
magicalSubstances.effect: Sleep produces a directed symbolic vision; Divination checks gain +2 until the next rest.
magicalSubstances.crash: Waking confusion; first failed Wisdom save before the next rest is made with disadvantage.

magicalSubstances.name: Redwake
magicalSubstances.description: Dark crimson stimulant carried by mercenary surgeons.
magicalSubstances.effect: Gain temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus and ignore one Wound penalty for 10 minutes.
magicalSubstances.crash: Take 1d6 damage when the effect ends and cannot benefit again until a long rest.

magicalSubstances.name: Moonsap
magicalSubstances.description: Cold luminous resin harvested from nocturnal flora.
magicalSubstances.effect: Gain darkvision 120 ft. and detect invisible movement within 10 ft. for 1 hour.
magicalSubstances.crash: Bright light imposes disadvantage on sight-based checks for 1 hour afterward.

magicalSubstances.name: Ghostwine
magicalSubstances.description: Translucent spirit that never reflects the drinker.
magicalSubstances.effect: Perceive ethereal creatures and spiritual residue for 10 minutes.
magicalSubstances.crash: At the end, make a Wisdom save or become Frightened by the nearest spirit or corpse for 1 minute.

magicalSubstances.name: Null Salt
magicalSubstances.description: Black crystals that deaden resonance on the tongue.
magicalSubstances.effect: Gain advantage against spells and reduce incoming spell damage by proficiency bonus for 1 minute.
magicalSubstances.crash: Cannot spend Resonance Points for 10 minutes after the effect ends.

magicalSubstances.name: Choir Dust
magicalSubstances.description: White-gold powder that makes every voice sound harmonious.
magicalSubstances.effect: Gain advantage on Charisma checks and resistance to psychic damage for 10 minutes.
magicalSubstances.crash: Gain 1 Unity Exposure; repeated use risks false resonance and identity loss.

magicalSubstances.name: Spiral Ink
magicalSubstances.description: Living ink absorbed through a marked paper wafer.
magicalSubstances.effect: Gain +2 on one Arcana, History, Religion, Nature, or Engineering research project for 8 hours.
magicalSubstances.crash: The user must pursue the chosen question or suffer disadvantage on concentration checks.

magicalSubstances.name: Deep Blue
magicalSubstances.description: Dense aquatic cordial used by divers and amphibian caravans.
magicalSubstances.effect: Breathe water and gain a swim speed equal to walking speed for 1 hour.
magicalSubstances.crash: Severe thirst; water requirement doubles for the next 8 hours.

magicalSubstances.name: Ember Resin
magicalSubstances.description: Warm amber paste used by furnace crews.
magicalSubstances.effect: Gain fire resistance and +1 damage with melee attacks for 10 minutes.
magicalSubstances.crash: Become irritable; disadvantage on checks to de-escalate conflict for 1 hour.

magicalSubstances.name: Saint's Ash
magicalSubstances.description: Gray-white suspension sold as miraculous relief.
magicalSubstances.effect: Immediately spend one Hit Die and maximize it; suppress Poisoned for 1 hour.
magicalSubstances.crash: The suppressed condition returns unless cured, and dependence develops quickly.

magicalSubstances.name: Wyrmspice
magicalSubstances.description: Metallic flakes that burn with an elemental aftertaste.
magicalSubstances.effect: Exhale a 15-ft cone dealing 3d6 chosen elemental damage, Dexterity save half.
magicalSubstances.crash: Take 1d6 damage of the same type and roll on the Mutation complication table on an overdose.

brews.name: Gatehouse Small Beer
brews.effect: Hydration-safe weak ale; grants no intoxication from one serving.

brews.name: Delver's Bitter
brews.effect: Advantage on the next save against spoiled food within 8 hours.

brews.name: Stoneback Stout
brews.effect: Ignore the first level of cold-weather exposure for 4 hours.

brews.name: Tidesilver Grog
brews.effect: Advantage on checks against seasickness for 8 hours.

brews.name: Embermark Porter
brews.effect: Fire resistance 1 against environmental heat for 1 hour.

brews.name: Verdant Leaf Wine
brews.effect: Gain +1 to one Nature or Performance check made during the meal.

brews.name: Mooncap Mead
brews.effect: Dreams reveal one emotional truth about the drinker; Wisdom save to avoid vivid nightmares.

brews.name: Thunder-Vein Ale
brews.effect: Gain +5 ft. speed for 10 minutes; one Intoxication afterward.

brews.name: Dragonblood Brandy
brews.effect: Advantage on one fear save; take 1 fire damage if consumed too quickly.

brews.name: Hollow Cask
brews.effect: Suppress hunger for 24 hours; healing received is reduced by 1 during that time.

brews.name: Choirless Absinthe
brews.effect: Hear no whispers or telepathy for 1 hour; cannot benefit from Bard Chants.

brews.name: Sovereign Reserve
brews.effect: A unique vintage that records the final spoken sentence of every drinker.
